budget_policy.after_lock: Honor phase ceilings; incomplete required phase stops dependent work, with checkpointed recovery only inside remaining reserve; no silent dose/seed/arm cuts
budget_policy.before_lock: Measure complete pipeline stages at two sizes; reduce draft dose/batch and re-budget before quality observations if needed
budget_policy.screen_overrun: No selection from an accidentally incomplete matrix; report incomplete screen and stop unless all registered arms complete within the existing reserve
budget_policy.unused_time: May move forward to the same registered work, never a new hypothesis; hard total remains 72h

checkpoint_averaging.audit_form: Ship seed 0 using the selected form; apply that same form to seed-0 matched control. Freeze both hashes before audit; no audit-driven fallback to the other form. Seed 1 is sensitivity evidence.
checkpoint_averaging.checkpoint_steps_note: Spread over the last quarter of the 6000-step schedule so the snapshots differ; the earlier 14000/15000/16000 window under decay-to-zero would have averaged near-identical tables.
checkpoint_averaging.operation: Equal arithmetic mean of effective float32 folded rows; no separate scalar average, per-row/global rescaling or cross-run/tokenizer averaging; quantize the result once
checkpoint_averaging.scale_diagnostic: Record effective-table RMS at each checkpoint; same initialization and row units, no data-dependent scale adjustment
checkpoint_averaging.scope: Each finalist/control full run, each seed; no averaging during short-arm selection
checkpoint_averaging.selection: See training.decision_protocol.averaging_rule; dev-suite predicates only, endpoint eligibility checked, no panel veto. No window/weight sweep.
checkpoint_averaging.snapshot_policy: Keep these step-bound snapshots in addition to time-bound recovery checkpoints; preserve schedule/step identity on resume

data.alias_admission: Context-valid independently checked equivalences from admitted sources; group source documents, near duplicates and same-intent query/alias-view families before discovery/training; teacher agreement alone is not a label

alias_heldout_test.definition: Independently judged same-intent pairs held out of all training, split from training pairs by query family; metric is top-10 overlap and rank correlation between the two views' exact dense results over the panel corpus, plus each view's nDCG@10 where judged
alias_heldout_test.reads: once per screen arm and once per final form, alongside the ordinary reads; descriptive, does not route selection

data.alias_sampling: Half of the targeted-coverage slots are paired equivalent views: 16 pairs/32 views at batch 256, 8 pairs/16 views at batch 128. Same views, pair IDs and order in every arm; both views count toward the query cap and exposure. SUPERSEDED by measured_dose_after_pre_lock_rule (204/32/10): the applied dose is 10 pairs / 20 views at batch 256 after the pre-lock alias shrink.
data.alias_spotcheck_rule: A3 (Dylan, 2026-09-11): Dylan checks the 308-pair 2% sample; if more than 5% of pairs are wrong, the abbreviation filter is tightened and the pool rebuilt before lock.
data.alias_test_status: built-provisional (2026-09-11, step 2c): 200 pairs, 164 families, 120 VERIFIED_BY_SOURCE and 80 PENDING_HUMAN (59 ambiguous-sense plus 21 truncated extractions); results/m17_alias_test_manifest.json. Excluded families and text keys for the training-pair builder: work/m17/manifest/alias_test_families.json.
data.ancestor_decontamination: Panel, held-out alias pairs and the 2000-query continuation holdout are screened not only against M17 inputs but against every available ancestor training manifest of p35w-2m-s2500 (M7 sources, pseudo-query pools and generated-query lineage) through the approved fingerprint interfaces. Where ancestry cannot be established, the family is labeled exposure-unknown and any generalization claim about it is limited accordingly. A sealed panel is not automatically unseen by the warm start (Astra P1).

bucket_populations_and_dose_rule.alias_training_pairs_source: Bulk structural equivalences from admitted sources (for example Wikipedia redirect titles to their target titles within admitted Wikipedia-derived datasets, and dataset-provided paraphrases), filtered by rule and spot-checked on a random 2% sample by a human. Individually judged pairs are reserved for the 200-pair held-out test. If fewer than 24000 distinct training pairs exist, the pre_lock_rule shrinks the alias share; it does not authorize new sources.

buckets_per_final_run_at_6000x256.note: at the applied dose (204/32/10 per batch). The earlier 1152000/192000/96000 was the pre-dose-rule figure, superseded by measured_dose_after_pre_lock_rule

bucket_populations_and_dose_rule.new_source_cap_basis: The 10% cap applies to processed views per run, not only to unique queries
bucket_populations_and_dose_rule.pre_lock_rule: After the support manifest, compute each bucket's deduplicated population. If any bucket would exceed 4 passes at the registered dose, first shrink that bucket's batch share (alias then coverage) down to a floor of 4 pairs/8 views and 16 coverage views per batch; if general still exceeds 4 passes, reduce final steps so it does not. Record the resulting numbers before lock. Never raise steps above 6000.
bucket_populations_and_dose_rule.sampling: Without replacement within a pass, reshuffled per pass with the run seed; passes counted per bucket, not overall

data.cap_fill_priority_note: A5 (Dylan, 2026-09-11): after every distinct admitted general query is in the pool, the alias bucket takes ALL distinct admitted pairs (not the four-pass minimum) and unpaired-coverage views fill the remaining slots up to training_query_cap. Deterministic; the dose rule then states the resulting passes.

data.documentless_sources_vote_note: A4 (Dylan, 2026-09-11): nqopen and triviaqa ship no document, so they contribute contexts and residuals to term discovery but no distinct-supporting-document vote toward new_term_min_distinct_source_documents.

int8_resident_loading.comparator: Eager-fp32-row numpy loader on identical selected int8 artifact and tokenizer
int8_resident_loading.environment: Linux WSL box, CPU governor and thread count recorded; results are labeled Linux measurements. The Mac M5 Pro reference-device measurement is a separate later gate, not inferred from these

int8_resident_loading.implementation_scope: Standalone M17 numpy loader: keep codes/scales resident, gather unique query token IDs, dequantize only gathered rows to float32, preserve sqrt pooling/normalization/fallback/API
int8_resident_loading.measurement: Separate fresh processes for load/steady/peak RSS and cold start; warmed alternating-order repeated latency batches, report p50/p95 of batch latency and throughput by stratum; no ANN or quality reselection
int8_resident_loading.ports: Verify existing ONNX/FastEmbed parity on the selected artifact; do not infer their memory/latency savings from numpy measurements or redesign their runtimes
int8_resident_loading.quantile_method: nearest-rank over all 1000 timed batches per stratum (200 per process x 5 processes), after 20 untimed warm-up batches per process
int8_resident_loading.selection: Adopt only if all conformance/fallback/empty/truncation/special-token fixtures pass, steady process RSS is lower, and each stratum's p95 ratio versus eager is <= screening_preferences_not_release_bars.query_p95_latency_ratio_max. Otherwise retain eager loader and record the failed probe.

protected_access: none: M13 six, reserved four and LoTTE are not M17 development surfaces
purpose: Zero v1.1 vocabulary and modest retrieval-quality improvement; planning only

training.alias_pre_lock_diagnostic: Report teacher cosine between the two views of each admitted pair (distribution) and the alias term's share of the total gradient norm on the rows in the real smoke; pairs whose teacher cosine is below 0.7 are flagged for re-verification, not silently kept
training.alias_selection: Superseded by decision_protocol.screen_ordering: VL-A beats VL only on the technical metric beyond the tie band while eligible; ties choose VL. The ambiguous-sense predicate was removed in A2 (Astra P1). This measures alias supervision conditional on expanded vocab and listwise loss, not every combination.
training.candidate_bank_note: Raised from 131072 so more labeled queries keep their positives inside the bank; fp16 vectors occupy 512 MiB. Still 8x smaller than M7's 2M bank, so candidates are softer than the B2 top-200 measurement.

candidate_construction.backfill: If teacher or v1 ranks are exhausted before their quota (bank smaller than needed), continue that source's ranked list beyond the nominal depth before moving on; uniform draws never fill a teacher/v1 quota
candidate_construction.bank_sampling: Bank = all known positives of the selected labeled subset, then uniform admitted documents stratified by source to the cap, seed recorded
candidate_construction.bank_sampling_amendment_a4: A4 (Dylan, 2026-09-11): the admitted new-source (Kubernetes) documents are reserved in the bank before the uniform stratified sample, inside the cap; the original bank_sampling text is retained above.
candidate_construction.positive_choice: If a labeled query has several known positives inside the bank, inject the one that appears first in the admitted dataset's own qrels order; the others stay eligible as teacher/v1 hits and are marked in has_label metadata
candidate_construction.provenance_counts: Record realized per-source candidate counts (positive/teacher/v1/uniform/backfill) over the whole cache and their distribution; overlap between teacher and v1 lists is reported
candidate_construction.quota_counting: Quotas count newly admitted unique documents. Walk teacher ranks in order, skipping the positive and duplicates, until 31 (or 32) new IDs; then v1 ranks the same way until 16 new IDs; then uniform draws until 16 new IDs
candidate_construction.rng: Uniform draws use numpy default_rng seeded with SHA-256(cache_seed || raw query text hash) truncated to 64 bits; recorded in cache identity
candidate_construction.score_ties: Break by ascending bank document ID

training.candidate_entropy_diagnostic: At cache build, record teacher-distribution entropy and p_max quantiles over each query's 64-candidate list at the registered temperature, in the same format as results/m8_b2_entropy.json; recorded regardless of the stop rule.
training.candidate_note: Cache has_label and nullable positive_id explicitly. Teacher hits are never relevance labels. Same bank/lists for all arms; admitted vectors only.

decision_protocol.artifact_binding: Every quality read is of the folded, quantized int8 table that would ship, never the unfolded training checkpoint
decision_protocol.averaging_rule: mean_last_three is chosen only if it is itself eligible in both seeds and its technical gain over the endpoint is > 0 in both seeds with mean gain > simple_arm_tie_band. Otherwise endpoint, provided endpoint is eligible; if neither form is eligible the run has no shippable form
decision_protocol.eligibility: An arm is eligible if general_macro loss vs v1 <= general_macro_ndcg_loss_tolerance AND every component loss vs v1 <= individual_general_component_loss_tolerance AND fused_macro loss vs v1 <= general_macro_ndcg_loss_tolerance
decision_protocol.final_seed_rule: Quality claim only if candidate minus control has the same sign in both seeds and the seed-0 gain exceeds simple_arm_tie_band. If the control wins in either seed, the artifact is the control's seed-0 table and the result is recorded as 'candidate did not beat control'
decision_protocol.general_metric: all_component_macro dense nDCG@10 over the six pinned components, plus the existing four-component fused_macro (fused reads do not exist for the two heldout components)
decision_protocol.lock: This block, the vocabulary list hash, tokenizer hash, sampler seed, candidate-cache identity and V0 export hash are committed before the V0 read or any real development read. Later changes are dated amendments that preserve and disclose prior observations
decision_protocol.no_survivor: If no arm is eligible, or C is the finalist, record 'no useful signal from this screen' and stop before full runs; the reserve is not spent on a second screen
decision_protocol.panel_and_alias_test_role: Never appear in any predicate above. They are reported beside the decision, with their registered expected standard error, and cannot veto or rescue an arm. The earlier ambiguous-sense veto and coverage-slice alternative are removed by this revision
decision_protocol.screen_ordering: Among eligible arms, an expanded/complex arm beats its matched control only if technical gain over that control > simple_arm_tie_band; otherwise the control is chosen. Walk the control map from the most complex arm: VL-A vs VL, then VL vs L and VL vs V (VL must beat both), then L vs C and V vs C. The finalist is the most complex arm that beat every matched control on its path; its matched control is the comparison arm for the full runs.
decision_protocol.technical_metric: dense nDCG@10 on cqadup-programmers only; the single software component in the pinned suite

training.final_steps_note: Cut from 16000 on 2026-09-11: 6000 x 256 = 1.54M query views, about 2.6 passes over a 600k pool and comparable to M7's final phase A dose (2500 x 512). Avoids ~14 passes over few queries with a memorizing lookup table.
training.init: M7 p35w-2m-s2500 unfolded checkpoint, lineage verified; new run IDs and optimizer
training.init_anchor_note: Coefficient inherited from M7's reg_init; the functional form (uniform MSE on effective folded rows) is not M7's update-count-scaled penalty, so this is coefficient continuity only. With row element RMS about 0.39, a 100% drift of every element adds about 1.5e-4 to the loss; it is intentionally weak and is not drift protection. Whether it is inert at the optimizer level is measured in the smoke, not asserted.
training.labeled_positive_budget_note: A4 (Dylan, 2026-09-11): the eligible labeled subset is chosen in seeded order before the bank exists so that all its positives fit in this share of candidate_bank_max_docs; the remainder are query-only and counted as query_only_by_bank_budget. Held-out (divergence-slice) queries are excluded from the positive budget so the training bank is not shaped by the monitoring slice. positive_bank_policy is unchanged.

loss_definition.alias: (2/B) * sum_verified_pairs_in_batch(1 - dot(q_s(view_a), q_s(view_b))), B = batch size; batch-normalized so a paired view's alias coefficient equals alias_weight times its per-view cosine coefficient (A2, Astra P2: the earlier per-pair mean gave each paired view 1.6x its teacher-cosine coefficient at weight 0.1). Both views retain their own ordinary teacher/candidate targets; no positive-document label is inferred
loss_definition.anchor: mean_squared_deviation of effective folded token rows from their M17 initialization, across rows and dimensions; same definition in all arms
loss_definition.cosine: mean_queries(1 - dot(q_s,q_t)); no positive-document centroid target
loss_definition.d: frozen normalized Stella document vectors, stored cache dtype recorded; no retraining or change to document preprocessing
loss_definition.listwise: mean_queries(sum_candidates(p_teacher * (log(p_teacher) - log(p_student)))); stable log_softmax; no extra T squared factor
loss_definition.logits: float32 dot(q_t,d)/T and dot(q_s,d)/T using the same T
loss_definition.q_s: L2-normalized student query from sqrt-count pooling
loss_definition.q_t: L2-normalized frozen Stella query vector for raw text with its pinned instruction
loss_definition.total: cosine_weight*cosine + enabled_listwise_weight*listwise + init_anchor_weight*anchor + enabled_alias_weight*alias; C/V omit listwise, only VL-A enables alias

training.new_row_initialization: new_row = sum_j sqrt(c_j) * R_eff_j over the lexical unit's own constituent pieces with their counts c_j as the original tokenizer produced them in isolation, excluding [CLS]/[SEP]; new scalar = 1. Plain summation over occurrences would initialize C++ as R_c + 2 R_+ where the original pool gave R_c + sqrt(2) R_+ (Astra P2). Cross-term sharing drift (P0b) remains and is measured by V0

optimizer.note: Pinned so the anchor's weakness is an empirical claim under these settings; the smoke records the anchor's share of the row update norm
optimizer.param_groups: rows at rows_lr, learned scalars at weights_lr, as in m7src/train.py

overfit_divergence_check.flag_rule: flag if held-out loss rises for two consecutive reads while train loss falls; a flag is recorded and reported, it does not change the schedule after lock
overfit_divergence_check.heldout_metric: same losses on a fixed 2000-query held-out slice of the training sources, never the panel
overfit_divergence_check.train_metric: running mean cosine and listwise loss on the training stream

training.positive_bank_policy: All known positives of the selected labeled-query subset fit inside this bank cap; choose eligible query subset before lock, never silently convert a labeled query to query-only
training.schedule: linear decay; screen and final are separate predeclared schedules
training.screen_routing_surface: The pinned M7/M8 development suite exactly as results/m7_dev_manifest.json _pinned.components lists it: nq-250k, hotpotqa, cqadup-programmers, cqadup-physics, heldout-train, heldout-longq (heavily reused selection evidence; hotpotqa and heldout-train are training-adjacent by construction). All reads are int8 folded artifacts through the released QueryTable path, exact dense retrieval.

uninformative_list_stop.rule: Before the screen, compute on the built cache the student-teacher KL at the warm start (v1 rows) per query. Stop the listwise arms only if the median warm-start KL is below 0.01 nats AND fewer than 20% of queries exceed 0.1 nats, meaning the student already reproduces the teacher's candidate distribution and the term has nothing to teach.
uninformative_list_stop.status: REPLACED in A2 (Astra P2): teacher entropy alone is descriptive; a one-hot teacher still gives gradient (p_s - p_t)/T when the student disagrees
uninformative_list_stop.surviving_matrix_if_stopped: C and V only, control map V->C, no full-run listwise arm; recorded as 'listwise inert at warm start'

untrained_vocab_export_v0.definition: Extended tokenizer with count-weighted sum-initialized new rows and unchanged old rows, folded and quantized exactly like a release; no optimizer step
untrained_vocab_export_v0.observation_boundary: Read only after decision_protocol.lock is committed. The vocabulary list may not be changed in response to the V0 read; a change is a dated amendment that keeps the V0 observation and reruns V0 as a second declared read
untrained_vocab_export_v0.purpose: Separates the effect of tokenization alone from joint training; costs minutes. Descriptive only, never a shippable candidate.

vocabulary_ranking.breadth_completion: The vocabulary outcome is 'broad' only if at least three domains contribute at least 64 rows each; otherwise it is recorded as 'narrow', which is a reported gap and not a failure of the run
vocabulary_ranking.domain_assignment: Majority domain of the term's supporting source documents. Domain of a document = the source-to-domain map (k8s-docs-en is cloud-software) except that documents from sources mapped to 'general' are assigned per document by the same heuristic keyword classifier the panel builder uses (m17src/panel_build.py, same threshold), so science-engineering, medicine, finance and legal can populate; labels are heuristic and recorded as such. A term with no majority is 'general'; each term counts toward exactly one domain cap. Ruling A3 (Dylan, 2026-09-11), pre-lock protocol refinement, no new source.
vocabulary_ranking.residual: For each candidate term, over the deduplicated training queries containing it, mean of (1 - dot(q_teacher, q_v1)) where q_v1 is the frozen v1 query vector; higher means v1 represents those queries worse
vocabulary_ranking.score: residual * support_weight; sort descending, then distinct_source_documents descending, then lexical ascending
